title: Compute brief — 18 September 2026
description: Oracle locks 433 MW West Texas VPPA with RWE (part of >1.7 GW Texas power book). CleanSpark names Meta as 175 MW Sandersville AI tenant and pitches $2.227B notes. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; 69 confirms, 0 ticks. PUCT 58481 still HOLD through Interchange item 217.
og_kicker: Oracle 433 MW VPPA; Meta named on 175 MW
lede: Texas power paper and a named Georgia tenant share the overnight print, while the Silicon Tape stays flat. RWE Americas said on 17 Sep it signed a 433 MW virtual PPA with Oracle from existing Panther Creek I–III wind in Sterling, Howard and Glasscock counties — framed as part of Oracle’s broader Texas portfolio of more than 1.7 GW supporting data-center load on ERCOT. Same day CleanSpark’s investor materials named Meta subsidiary Anviran LLC as the tenant on the previously announced 175 MW Sandersville, Georgia AI lease (~$6.6B initial-term revenue), with a PR Newswire pitch for $2.227B senior notes due 2031 to finish the campus (offering not closed). PUCT Project 58481 remains HOLD: Interchange still shows 217 filings and no stamped Order Adopting after the 18 Sep open meeting agenda. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints.
